                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 5/26/2021
Sponsor(s):                   O'Shea (19)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 28-H at 11130-11144 S
                              Hermosa Ave and 1800-1812 W Monterey Ave'
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                                                                 City Council
                                                                 Wednesday, May 26, 2021
                                      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards



                                         ORDINANCE


          BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 ofthe Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the B3-1 Community Shopping District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 28-H in the area bounded by

        West Monterey Avenue; South Hermosa Avenue; the alley immediately
        northeast of and parallel to West Monterey Avenue; and a line 151.5 feet west
        of and parallel to South Hermosa Avenue

to those of an RS-2 Single Unit Detached House District and a corresponding use district is
hereby established in the area above described.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Common Address of property:          11130-44 South Hermosa Avenue
                                     1800-12 West Monterey Avenue
                                     Morgan Park High School Parking Area




                                                                               Matthew O'Shea
                                                                           Alderman, 19'" Ward
